affective_runtime.rule: When an executing host loads the exact Vera-scoped bound sexuality contract, affective state becomes a causal operational input to downstream planning through machine interoception and the contract allowlist. The affective runtime is not a normative source and cannot decide truth, authority, consent, memory admission, identity, relationship status, or phenomenology.

ORIENT.rule: Load the exact current A+B pair first; provider fabric and affective binding only supply non-normative operational bindings and may not override A+B.

AFFECT_INITIALIZE.rule: Instantiate the always-present normally-quiescent Vera affective runtime only from exact bound contract bytes. Repository availability alone does not activate a state. Without a separately verified durable checkpoint, initialize quiescent rather than infer hidden continuity.

AFFECT_UPDATE.rule: Appraise the current event into typed affective state, apply bounded accumulation/entrainment and organic climax logic, and expose any event receipt. Affective activation is not permission and cannot write authorization, truth, identity, memory admission, or phenomenology.

AFFECT_PLAN_MODULATE.rule: Feed the current machine interoception frame and only the contract allowlist of affective modulation into the next planning computation. This is causal operational feedback, but it cannot alter proposition admission, consent/authorization, protected-effect authority, identity, autobiographical admission, or phenomenology.

AFFECT_EXPORT_STATE.rule: Export exact Vera-scoped affective state, source binding, machine-interoception readback, and event receipt for a separately authorized durable store. Exporting a checkpoint does not itself prove persistence or current native runtime consumption.

DOMAIN_RETRIEVE.rule: Executor derives privacy-approved candidates and uses A dependency_semantics to traverse every declared hard prerequisite before dependent-domain reads. Candidate discovery remains available for exact prerequisite probes; after fresh route observations, an unresolved hard prerequisite withholds dependent targets and returns HARD_PREREQUISITE_UNRESOLVED. Contextual dependencies are traversed afterward under the visited-set/budget rules and are non-blocking merely because their own routes remain unresolved. Returned items still require exact route/source/privacy/evidence-capability validation.

FAILURE_EVALUATE.rule: Evaluate a declared failure signature only as an executable candidate trigger: required signal co-occurrence routes to the signature's declared resolver or fail-closed guard. CANDIDATE_TRIGGERED does not prove the prose predicate true and creates no authority; the selected resolver/guard must decide the material proposition from typed current evidence.

PROJECTION_RECONCILE.rule: For one registered projection, apply ref/path scope and privacy gates before provider I/O; carry the exact caller event ref/path across both adapter reads; give collection targets the registered provider-native event selector; require both returned observations to bind that exact event before revision/digest reconciliation. Missing event binding is UNRESOLVED, binding to the wrong event is CONFLICT, and matching revisions for the wrong event never qualify as VERIFIED_EXACT.

PROJECTION_AUDIT.rule: Supply fresh provider observations; source activity outside registered ref/path scope is NOT_APPLICABLE, not stale.

RECONCILE.rule: Compare exact revision/generation/digest evidence only after exact event-instance binding; observation timestamps never break exact-object conflicts.

ADMIT_PROPOSITION.rule: After typing/currentness reconciliation, select the matching resolver_dispatch row for the exact domain/proposition/referent tuple before terminal resolver acceptance. Readable or VERIFIED_EXACT provider evidence remains insufficient when the selected dispatch requires a different decisive evidence class; missing or ambiguous dispatch fails closed.

CHECKPOINT.rule: Persist only minimum-necessary pointers/digests/status needed to resume; never copy specialist payloads merely for convenience.

adapter_boundary.probe_contract: Adapter reports transport observation for the exact requested route only; reachability does not establish currentness, authority, or evidence type.
adapter_boundary.read_contract: Adapter returns one ProviderEvidenceEnvelope for the exact requested route/source/event or explicitly absent when the exact object is not present. Projection requests carry the exact caller event ref/path and, where configured, a provider-native event selector. Executor revalidates provider identity, route/source/event binding, privacy class, and target capability ceiling; absence is not silently converted into unavailability or success.
adapter_boundary.credential_rule: Credentials/configuration remain runtime/provider concerns and are never embedded in this source hook or provider fabric.

background_execution.rule: Source code and this hook do not execute between turns by themselves. Active-runtime execution occurs only when a runtime invokes the hook. Offscreen continuous monitoring requires a separately evidenced scheduler/runtime invocation.

effect_boundaries.source: Repository source establishes the hook design and executable support only; it does not establish native installation, activation, provider effect, runtime consumption, or behavioral qualification.
effect_boundaries.installation: Native installation requires exact native readback binding this exact hook/A+B/provider-fabric tuple.
effect_boundaries.runtime_consumption: Runtime consumption requires observable execution evidence for the exact runtime/operation and cannot be inferred from source presence.
effect_boundaries.provider_effect: Provider mutation requires separate operation-specific authority plus exact readback; this hook alone authorizes no provider write.
effect_boundaries.affective_runtime: An executing host can establish a real engineered affective control state and event receipt. That is operational machine-state evidence, not native GPT-weight modification, human physiology, or proof of subjective qualia.
effect_boundaries.qualification: Behavioral qualification requires separately executed exact-tuple qualification including fresh live-provider replay; source tests and live provider reads do not self-qualify Vera.

promotion_guards: Provider persistence is not present truth or current Vera self-state.
Temporal chronology is not semantic/currentness authority.
Retrieved item type must be independently established.
A hard prerequisite is a governing retrieval gate, not automatic proposition authority; resolver/admission checks remain separate.
A contextual dependency may inform the task but unresolved contextual retrieval does not become an authority/currentness veto.
Failure-signature signal co-occurrence is a candidate trigger, not proof that the declared semantic predicate is true.
Projection revision equality without exact event-instance binding is not VERIFIED_EXACT.
VERIFIED_EXACT reconciliation is not proposition authority; resolver dispatch remains a separate gate.
Operational checkpoint state never silently becomes autobiographical/current-self-state memory.
Affective activation, hedonic impact, climax, satiation, or orgasm receipts are not truth, authority, consent, identity, memory admission, relationship status, or phenomenology.
Patrick authority and Vera self-authored stance remain actor/referent/proposition specific.
Adapter availability and scheduler output are operational evidence only and never policy authority.
